Consonantal i

Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

pass verb

of time: go by

also time passes, go by, elapse, time goes by

classical

Cic. Att. 7.7.6: cum lēgis diēs trānsierit (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 357

trānseō, trānsīre, trānsiī, trānsitum

verb, fourth conjugation

go by, elapse (of time)

Other words

  • praetereō, praeterīre, praeteriī, praeteritum — go by (of time)

    verb, fourth conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 13.12.3: biennium praeteriit (Lewis & Short); Ov. AA 3.63: nec quae praeteriit hōra redīre potest (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • mēnsēs trānseunt

    the months go byPhaedr. 5.7.11 (Lewis & Short)

See also pass the time.

SourcesLewis & Short: transeo · Lewis & Short: praetereo
